prose: Bloomberg sources, as summarized by Techmeme, say CoreWeave plans to raise at least $4 billion through an investment-grade loan, potentially as soon as the following week. The feed reports a prospective yield of 7%-7.5%, described as roughly half the yield on its junk bonds. This is a reported financing plan, not a completed borrowing; the original article was unavailable.
highlights: Reported loan target of at least $4 billion
Terms and timing are not final
basis: Techmeme headline and excerpt of Bloomberg reporting; source fetch failed.
